intro.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Cleveland, backed by 22 years of work
paragraphs: Keselman Construction Group has offered kitchen remodeling in Cleveland and its suburbs since 2004. Designers, estimators, project managers and craftsmen all work in-house, out of a showroom in Solon. More than 3,000 finished projects later, about 80% of new work still comes from referrals.

The crew's recent work shows the range. A Solon range wall with a hood that matches the lower cabinets. A Pepper Pike basement with a backlit media wall and a wet bar. Two bold Solon baths, one with a crane print and a coral vanity. Reviewers name their project managers, Ivan and Sergiy, and say the crews were efficient and kept them informed.

services.h2: What the Keselman team designs and builds

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Your designer starts with a floor plan and 3D renderings, then the estimating team prices the cabinets, counters and labor line by line. Recent kitchens in Solon, Beachwood, Lakewood and Eastlake mix painted shaker cabinets, white oak and big islands with seating.

image.alt: Solon, OH kitchen remodel with sage green cabinets, white quartz island, glass pendant lights and a stainless range

items.name: Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: From quiet hall baths to statement rooms. One Solon project paired palm wallpaper with a leopard tile floor, and its neighbor got a crane print, a coral vanity and teal trim. Spa-style primary baths with glass showers and double vanities are just as common.

image.alt: Solon, OH powder bath remodel with crane-print wallpaper, coral vanity with open shelves, oval lighted mirror and brass faucet

items.name: Basement Remodels
items.blurb: Basements are designed in renderings before anyone swings a hammer. Home gyms, saunas, wet bars, guest rooms and media walls are all on the list. The Pepper Pike basement finished in October 2026 added a lounge, a backlit TV wall and a full bath.

image.alt: Pepper Pike, OH basement remodel with dark media wall, backlit TV, lighted oak shelving and sectional sofa

items.name: Whole-Home Remodels and Additions
items.blurb: For homeowners ready to change more than one room, the same in-house team handles full remodels, home additions and custom new homes. The Eastlake remodel posted in October 2026 opened the kitchen to the dining room and updated the baths.

image.alt: Eastlake, OH home remodel with open kitchen, navy island, hardwood floors and dining area by the windows

items.name: Fire and Water Damage Reconstruction
items.blurb: After a fire, water or sewage loss, Keselman moves from clean-up to a full rebuild, often finishing with a remodeled room. Past jobs include a Shaker Heights reconstruction, a Mayfield Heights fire restoration and a Lyndhurst kitchen rebuilt after a house fire.

image.alt: Lyndhurst, OH kitchen rebuilt by Keselman Construction Group after a house fire

items.title: Judged best by local builders
items.text: At the 2025 Cleveland Choice Awards from HBA Greater Cleveland, Keselman took eight first places, including Kitchen Renovation Under $100,000 and both bathroom renovation classes.

items.title: Estimates you can read
items.text: Once drawings are final, suppliers price the materials and the estimating team writes a detailed proposal with labor scope and finish allowances. It usually takes two weeks or less.

items.title: One project manager, live updates
items.text: Each job gets its own project manager and a timeline in project management software that you can follow. Google reviewers single out how their project managers kept them informed.

items.title: Financing through Regions Bank
items.text: Pre-qualify online with a soft credit pull. Plans include 9-month same-as-cash and an 11.99% APR loan of up to 12 years, on approved credit. FHA 203k help is offered too.

about.h2: The people behind Keselman Construction Group
about.text: Keselman Construction Group is led by Zakhar Keselman, partner and CEO, who also holds certifications through the Institute of Inspection Cleaning and Restoration. That training sits behind the firm's fire and water rebuild work. The design side is staffed by NARI Certified Remodeling Designers, including Diana Dyachuk and Jordan Suglio. An Estimate Consultant meets you first, at your home or at the Solon showroom. A dedicated project manager then runs the build. The company says it is not a national franchise or a sales-driven operation, but a local team of craftsmen.

process.h2: Six steps on the site, five stages for you

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: The Estimate Consultant meets you at home or at the Solon office, talks through goals and budget, and gives an approximate estimate when possible.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: The staff designer listens first, then draws a floor plan and 3D renderings. You review and revise them before anything is final.

steps.title: Pricing and planning
steps.text: Suppliers price the drawings, and you get a detailed proposal by email, a review meeting, then a contract and draw schedule.

steps.title: Pre-production
steps.text: You pick finishes so orders go in on time. Your project manager and estimator walk the site with you and set the shared timeline.

steps.title: Build and punch list
steps.text: Work starts once materials and permits are in. A final walk-through creates a punch list, the touch-up crew closes it, and your warranty begins.

service_area.h2: From Solon to Lakewood: towns we remodel in
service_area.text: Keselman works from a showroom on Davis Industrial Parkway in Solon, open by appointment, and remodels homes across Greater Cleveland. The east side is close to home, with recent jobs in Solon, Pepper Pike, Beachwood and Eastlake. West-side work reaches Lakewood, Rocky River and Avon Lake, and the south runs to Broadview Heights and Richfield. If your town is not listed, call and ask.

items.a: Yes. Keselman offers a free remodeling consultation. The Estimate Consultant meets you at your home or at the Solon office. You talk through why you are remodeling, set a budget you can stick to, and look at what your home could become. When possible, you also get an approximate estimate based on your ideas.

items.q: How long does it take to get a full estimate?
items.a: Once your design or blueprint is done, the drawings go to suppliers for material pricing while the estimating team writes the labor scope and finish allowances. The process typically takes two weeks or less. The estimate arrives by email, followed by a meeting to review it and make changes before a contract is drawn up.

items.q: Can I finance a kitchen or bath remodel?
items.a: Yes, through Regions Bank on approved credit. Options listed on the site include a 9-month same-as-cash loan, a traditional installment loan from 8.99% to 24.49% APR, and an 11.99% APR loan of up to 12 years. You can pre-qualify online with a soft credit pull. FHA 203k and HomeStyle loan help is also offered.

items.q: Can I visit your showroom in Solon?
items.a: Yes, by appointment. The showroom is at 6500 Davis Industrial Pkwy, Solon, OH 44139, and the office keeps hours Monday to Friday, 8 am to 4 pm. Call (216) 208-6365 to set a time. Many clients pick finishes there with the staff designer during the pre-production stage.

items.q: Are you insured, and what happens at the end of a job?
items.a: The company states it is insured and bonded with each city it works in. Near the end of construction, your project manager walks the home with you and writes a punch list. The touch-up crew then finishes every item on it, and your warranty begins once that list is closed out.

final_cta.h2: Start with a free consultation in Solon or at home
final_cta.text: Call the Keselman team Monday to Friday, 8 am to 4 pm, or send the form and an Estimate Consultant will set up your first meeting.
